Settings.description: Telnyx SMS provider settings, independent of the Telnyx voice settings.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the UI-configured Telnyx SMS provider is enabled.

ApiKey.description: Telnyx API key (v2) presented as a bearer token on the Messaging API. Secret: supply it in clear text and it is data-protected before it is stored. It is never exported, and when it is omitted or empty the destination keeps the value it already stores.

MessagingProfileId.description: Optional Telnyx messaging profile identifier used when sending.

WebhookPublicKey.description: Telnyx webhook Ed25519 public key (base64) used to verify inbound messaging webhooks. Secret: supply it in clear text and it is data-protected before it is stored. It is never exported, and when it is omitted or empty the destination keeps the value it already stores.

ApiBaseUrl.description: Optional override of the Telnyx REST API base address. Empty uses https://api.telnyx.com/v2/.
